name: Serbia

elections.noteIs: 250 þingsæti, hlutfallskosning með lokuðum listum, 3% þröskuldur.

leaders: Acting President Ana Brnabić (since Sept 2026); Prime Minister Đuro Macut
leadersIs: Ana Brnabić, starfandi forseti (frá september 2026); Đuro Macut forsætisráðherra
summary: Aleksandar Vučić resigned as president on 27 September 2026 to lead the SNS list as candidate for prime minister. The snap vote follows two years of student-led anti-corruption protests, and the Student List is campaigning door to door.
summaryIs: Aleksandar Vučić sagði af sér sem forseti 27. september 2026 til að leiða lista SNS sem forsætisráðherraefni. Kosningarnar koma í kjölfar tveggja ára mótmæla gegn spillingu undir forystu námsmanna og listi þeirra, Studentska lista, gengur hús úr húsi í kosningabaráttunni.

parties.name: United Serbia (SNS-led)
policies: Vučić is the list's candidate for prime minister
Balances EU accession with close ties to Russia and China
Infrastructure and investment-led growth (Expo 2027)
Rejects protesters' corruption allegations
policiesIs: Reynir að samræma aðildarviðræður við ESB og náin tengsl við Rússland og Kína
Hagvöxtur drifinn áfram af innviðum og fjárfestingu (Expo 2027)

parties.name: Student List
parties.leader: Citizens' group from the protest movement
policies: Fulfil the demands of the anti-corruption protests
Independent judiciary and accountability for corruption
Reform of education and healthcare
Equality before the law
policiesIs: Sjálfstætt dómskerfi og að spilling hafi afleiðingar

parties.name: Platform for a European Serbia (SSP–SRCE)
policies: Accelerate EU accession
Cooperation with the Student List after the vote
Anti-corruption and media freedom
Strengthen democratic institutions
policiesIs: Samstarf við Studentska lista eftir kosningar
Barátta gegn spillingu og fyrir fjölmiðlafrelsi

parties.name: Socialist Party of Serbia
policies: Junior partner of the governing SNS
Runs jointly with JS, Zeleni and SDPS
Emphasises pensions and social security
Supports continuity of current foreign policy
policiesIs: Býður fram sameiginlega með JS, Zeleni og SDPS
Leggur áherslu á lífeyri og almannatryggingar

parties.name: National Democratic Alternative
policies: National conservative and Orthodox Christian values
Opposes recognition of Kosovo
Sceptical of EU accession conditions
Backs joint opposition effort against SNS
policiesIs: Efins um skilyrði fyrir aðild að ESB
Styður sameiginlegt átak stjórnarandstöðunnar gegn SNS

chamber.name: National Assembly
chamber.asOf: outgoing assembly; SSP–SRCE counts SSP and SRCE groups
chamber.asOfIs: fráfarandi þing; SSP–SRCE telur þingflokka SSP og SRCE saman
